attributes.description: Elasticsearch/Kibana operational log dashboard for the Self-Healing Data Pipeline. Covers repair volume, failure-class distribution, and success/rejection/failure outcome breakdown, sourced entirely from the application's existing structured JSON logs shipped by Filebeat. MLflow remains the system of record for LLM tracing, spans, and token/cost; PostgreSQL remains the system of record for repair audit/episodes. Use the separate 'Repair episode trace explorer' saved search to inspect one episode's full log sequence by trace_id.
attributes.title: Self-Healing Pipeline — Operational Log Dashboard
